//: Capability manifest for tab_item/1 (fragment of Tabs) — keen-pure-admin. The tab button's active state is an EXPLICIT `is_active` attr the author sets. keen REQUIRES `target` (no default) — it is the server-side switching handle: tab_item/1 emits id="tab-btn-{target}", data-tab-target="{target}", and phx-click={switch_tab(target,...)}. The id + data-tab-target are extra DOM the core oracle (snippets/tabs.html bare buttons) doesn't bless; they're the id/data siblings of phx-click and are trimmed as wiring by tabs-composed.json's PER-COMPONENT `normalize` block, so keen composes clean against the class contract. See fixtures/tabs-composed.json.
